ui_foreground_colour.meaning: Title of the normal foreground colour editor and one part of combined foreground/background status contentDescription. Foreground is the current opaque drawing colour used by ordinary strokes, flood fill, shape outlines/most fills and text, rather than a distinct image layer.
complete_context: AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show conditional title, preview, validation and commit
ColourStatusButton.kt: refresh combined contentDescription and target callbacks
ClassicPaintActivity.kt: colourStatus construction, colourDialog, setColour, updateColours
PaintDocument.kt: foreground setter, drawingPaint, floodFill, drawShape, drawText
ui_foreground_colour.qualification: Does not select/reorder a front layer, describe photographic foreground depth, change all existing pixels or promise immediate painting. Current value may preview before confirmation. Short FG caption and hex-specific Edit colour accessibility templates are separate untranslated resources.

ui_background_colour.meaning: Title of normal background-colour editor, combined status description, and existing custom-slot context-menu action assigning that swatch to document.background. Background is current opaque secondary/erase/fill colour, not a layer.
complete_context: AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show conditional title and callback
ClassicPaintActivity.kt: colourDialog, editPaletteColour action0, setColour, updateColours
PaintDocument.kt: background setter, drawingPaint eraser, drawShape style2 fill, clear/new/resize/selection deletion/text background
ui_background_colour.qualification: Changing property alone does not repaint the whole existing image. It is used by subsequent erasing/clearing/new canvas/fill operations and some geometry previews; not OS wallpaper or app theme. Existing ui_edit_background inherited wording is reference history, not new acceptance.

ui_swap23.meaning: Colour dock button exchanges the two current document colour properties via a temporary variable, then refreshes status, invalidates canvas and schedules autosave.
complete_context: ClassicPaintActivity.kt: colourHeader swap button and updateColours
ui_swap23.qualification: Swaps current foreground/background colours only, not arbitrary palette slots, image layers, pixel colour inversion, black/white reset or selected pixels. Existing pixels are not rewritten by the callback; invalidation can affect previews. No forced colour reversal terminology from fuzzy exchange evidence.

limits: Three plain labels, no placeholders/units/ellipsis. Combined status joins two labels using slash externally; no concatenated-template linguistic acceptance inferred.
